subject: Regarding Your Recent Order
body: Dear [Customer Name], We hope this email finds you well. We wanted to update you on the status of your recent order (#12345) placed on our website. Your order is currently being processed and is expected to be shipped by the end of this week. Once your order has been dispatched, you will receive a confirmation email with the tracking details. If you have any questions or need further assistance, please feel free to contact our customer support team. Thank you for choosing our services. Best regards, [Your Company]
